report:
Kidney and ureter, left, nephroureterectomy

Received in formalin is a nephroureterectomy specimen comprising a kidney measuring 115 x 60 x 45 mm and a ureter measuring 240 mm in length and 6 mm in diameter, with a cuff of bladder. The specimen weighs 290 g. There is a papillary tumour in the renal pelvis measuring 35 x 25 x 15 mm, 25 mm from the closest (renal hilar soft tissue) margin. The renal pelvis and calyces are dilated. Representative sections are taken in 14 blocks.

(1-4) Tumour with renal parenchyma and renal sinus fat.
(5) Renal hilar soft tissue margin and vessels.
(6-8) Ureter, proximal to distal.
(9) Bladder cuff margin.
(10-11) Non-neoplastic kidney.
(12-14) Hilar lymph nodes.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Nephroureterectomy, complete
- Specimen laterality: Left
- Tumour site: Renal pelvis
- Tumour size: 35 mm (greatest dimension)
- Tumour focality: Unifocal

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Urothelial carcinoma, invasive (conventional)
- Tumour histology:
  The tumour is a high-grade urothelial carcinoma invading the renal parenchyma. Irregular nests and single cells with nuclear pleomorphism, hyperchromasia and frequent mitoses infiltrate the stroma. There is also focal carcinoma in situ, in which flat urothelium shows loss of polarity and nuclear crowding, with enlarged, pleomorphic nuclei and mitoses in the mid to upper layers.
- Histologic grade: High grade
- Tumour configuration: Papillary and solid / nodule
- Lymphovascular invasion: Present
- Perineural invasion: Not identified
- Tumour extension: Invades the renal parenchyma; carcinoma in situ (focal)

Margins
- Bladder cuff margin: Uninvolved (200 mm)
- Soft tissue margin: Uninvolved (25 mm)

Lymph nodes
- Regional lymph nodes: 3 examined; none involved

Pathological stage (AJCC 8th edition)
- pTNM: pT3 pN0

Additional findings
- Additional findings: Inflammation / regenerative changes
- Ipsilateral non-neoplastic renal tissue: Vascular disease
  (arterionephrosclerosis)

Ancillary studies
- Mismatch repair (MMR) immunohistochemistry: Intact nuclear expression of MLH1,
  PMS2, MSH2 and MSH6

KIDNEY AND URETER, left, nephroureterectomy
- INVASIVE UROTHELIAL CARCINOMA of the renal pelvis, high grade, 35 mm, invading
  the renal parenchyma, with carcinoma in situ; completely excised (closest
  margin 25 mm, soft tissue); see synoptic report
- 0 of 3 regional lymph nodes involved
- pT3 pN0 (AJCC 8th edition)
